final: WITH c AS (SELECT z.city AS city, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS cnt FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), s AS (SELECT city, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM a)) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM a)
